description: This file is a shell script primarily used for testing Windows path handling in a Git environment, including UNC paths, administrative shares, and cross-platform path conversions.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for the presence of certain prerequisites, e.g., CYGWIN or MINGW.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that must succeed.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates an initial commit in the test repository.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in command output.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Ensures that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_done
